acquisition method: raw MS data were acquired in the data-dependent acquisition mode
alkylation reagent: before the gel pieces were placed in 100 μL of 55 mM iodoacetamide and incubated in the dark for 20 min.
alkylation concentration: before the gel pieces were placed in 100 μL of 55 mM iodoacetamide and incubated in the dark for 20 min.
cleavage agent: digested with 13 ng/μL trypsin (sequencing grade, Promega, USA) in 50 mM NH4HCO3 overnight at 37 °C.
fractionation method: We excised each of the three predominant bands from an IEF gel of urine samples
instrument: coupled to a Q-Exactive mass spectrometer through an EASY-Spray nano-electrospray ionization source
ionization type: coupled to a Q-Exactive mass spectrometer through an EASY-Spray nano-electrospray ionization source
labeling: The eluted peptides were electrosprayed into the mass spectrometer, and raw MS data were acquired in the data-dependent acquisition mode.
precursor tolerance: The mass deviation of the precursor ion, the fragment ion tolerance and the false discovery rate were set to 10 ppm, 0.05 Da and 0.01, respectively.
fragment tolerance: The mass deviation of the precursor ion, the fragment ion tolerance and the false discovery rate were set to 10 ppm, 0.05 Da and 0.01, respectively.
ptm: acrylamide modification of cysteines (fixed); methionine oxidation (dynamic)
The acrylamide modification of cysteines and methionine oxidation were set as fixed and dynamic modifications, respectively.
reduction reagent: incubating them with 100 μL of 10 mM dithiothreitol at 56 °C for 30 min
reduction concentration: incubating them with 100 μL of 10 mM dithiothreitol at 56 °C for 30 min
